coverage.named_error_and_warning_callbacks: Two anonymous condition handlers in mixture module also inspected; not independent exported or named responsibilities.
coverage.scope_exclusions: Adjacent context, fitting, cache, storage and S4 modules inspected only at call boundaries; all-package/native audit belongs to coordinator.

functions.name: run_crt_in_memory_v2::perform_association_analysis
